data.one_liner: Converts currency amounts to words in the Indian Locale up to Crore.
data.what_it_does: Provides a utility class to translate double values into Indian currency word representations. It supports an optional ignoreDecimal parameter to handle paisa or whole numbers.
use_when: You are building money-related apps or payroll systems targeting Indian users.
You need to display numerical amounts as written text in Indian numbering format.
avoid_when: You need conversions for numbers larger than 999,999,999.
You need locales other than Indian.
weaknesses: Limited to a maximum number of 999,999,999.
